brief:
Israeli occupation forces arrested three aid truck drivers in Rafah, according to Shehab Wire. The detentions mark the latest incident affecting humanitarian operations in the southern Gaza enclave, where aid delivery has faced mounting obstacles amid an extended Israeli blockade.

The arrests occurred as aid organizations struggle to distribute assistance to civilians across Gaza. The three drivers were transporting supplies when taken into custody, though specific details about the circumstances and charges were not immediately disclosed. The incident underscores escalating restrictions on aid workers and vehicles attempting to deliver food, medical supplies, and other necessities to the territory's population.
